before: So Kakarro found friends. Weaklings, every one of you.
He has Gokan's boy. Strike together, and don't hold back.
after: Impossible... Nappo and Vegara will come. They are far stronger than I am...
Two more Saiyars, in one year. We have a lot of training to do.

before: Heh. Vegara, can I squash these bugs before Kakarro shows up?
He's made of iron. Keep him busy and I'll find an opening.
after: He's down. But Vegara hasn't even moved yet.

before: I am the prince of all Saiyars. You are nothing to me.
Watch the sky: if he makes a moon, he turns into a Great Ape!
Then I'll beat you before the moon rises.
after: Defeated by low-class trash... This isn't over. I'll be back, stronger!
Let him go... Gokan says he's earned another chance. I hope he's right.

before: Another village, another Dragon Orb. Burn it down!
after: Lord Frigor will hear about this...
Thank you. Nameck will not forget you.

before: Such a pity. I do hate fighting in my ugly form.
Get the Dragon Orb away from him!
Then don't make me see it.
after: Even my true form... wasn't enough...
We've got the radar and the ball. Let's move before Frigor notices!

before: Ginnu Force, pose! Ah... I'm first. Don't blink, or you'll miss me freeze time!
Strike when he runs out of breath. He can only stop time while he holds it.
after: One down. The rest of the Ginnu Force won't be such a joke.

before: Rekume! Eraser! Gun! Hold still, little fighter.
He's all muscle and no brains. Hit him where it hurts.
I'm the fastest in the universe. You won't even see me coming.
after: How... how were you faster than me?

before: The Ginnu Force doesn't lose, mate. Crusher Ball!
The captain is behind him. Finish this quickly.
Captain Ginnu! Your body has a fine power level. I think I'll take it.
Don't let him swap bodies with you! Stay out of the light of his technique!
after: The Ginnu Force is finished. Now only Frigor remains.

before: You've ruined my plans for immortality. For that, I'll take my time with you.
He has transformed again... Fight with everything Nameck gave you.
Every planet is mine. Shall I show you why?
after: No... a Super Saiyar... the legend was true...
Nameck is breaking apart. Go, now, while you still can!

before: Rebuilt with machine parts, and Earth will be the first to pay.
I'll handle this. Watch closely... and help if you can keep up.
after: Frigor won't hurt anyone again. But his father is still here.

before: Young man, would you like to join my army? You'd make a fine soldier.
after: Gather everyone. I have something to tell you about the future.

before: Energy absorption ready. Your ki will make a fine meal.
Don't fire ki blasts! He drinks energy through his palms. Use your fists.
after: One down. The old one is Dr. Gerro himself. Don't let him escape.

before: I have watched every fight you've had. I know exactly how to win.
Then you missed the last one.
after: No matter... my real creations are still waiting...
He's heading for his lab! He's going to wake the others!

before: Gerro's dead. We're free. Now, how about some fun?
These two are nothing like 19 and 20. Careful.
after: Not bad. You're more interesting than Gerro said.

before: Don't touch my clothes, and maybe I'll go easy on you.
after: Fine. You win this one. Don't get used to it.

before: I have the cells of every great fighter... and I am still hungry.
If he absorbs Cyborgs 17 and 18, he becomes perfect. Stop him here!
after: You haven't won... I only need to find the androids...

before: Welcome to the Cel Games. I am perfect, and I will prove it before the whole world.
My dad told me to fight... I'll stand with you.
The world isn't your audience, Cel.
after: This is... impossible... I am perfect...
It's over. Dad... we did it.

before: Babido's mark gives me strength. You will not leave this ring.
Babido controls him. Follow him afterwards, and we will find the wizard.
after: Quickly. Their ship is hidden nearby, and Babido is gathering energy for Majinn Boo.

before: Welcome to the first floor of Babido's ship. You won't reach the second.
So much light inside you... I will eat it all.
He feeds on light. Give him more than he can swallow!
after: Dabora! Show them the power of the Demon King!

before: I am king of the Demon Realm. My spit turns fighters to stone.
Then I won't get close... until I do.
after: Majinn Boo will finish what I started...
Ooh, and now I have a better servant in mind... the Saiyar prince!

before: I let Babido into my heart to become the old Vegara again. Merciless.
after: Bulna... Tronks... take care of them...
He sacrificed himself... but Majinn Boo has awoken.

before: Boo wants to play! Then Boo turns you into candy!
after: Boo... tired. Boo not want to be bad.
Something is changing inside him... this isn't over.

before: I absorbed the strongest. Who is left to stop me?
after: No... my body... something inside is coming loose...

before: This is Boo's purest form. Pure chaos. Hold him while I gather the Spirit Sphere!
Everyone on Earth, raise your hands!
after: Majinn Boo is gone. Next time, I hope he comes back as a good guy. I'd like to fight him again.

before: You dare spill my pudding? The Earth will pay for that.
Oh dear. Lord Beeros, perhaps a game instead of destruction?
If you want a fight, fight me.
after: Hmm. You're amusing. I'll spare this planet... for its food.
Lord Beeros is satisfied. How rare.

before: Frigor's army has returned, and our lord is with us.
There's a thousand of them! Stay close!
after: That's the commander down. Now for Frigor...

before: Lord Frigor wishes the Earth's fighters dead. I'll gladly oblige.
after: Pathetic. I suppose I'll have to do it myself.

before: Four months of training. Behold: Golden Frigor.
Gold or not, we beat you once.
after: Curse you... curse all of you!
He's gone. Wiss rewound time just in case... too close.

before: Botama! Show them Universe 6 is superior!
I am a defender of peace in Universe 6. A pleasure.
Something about you reminds me of Frigor.
after: A hidden needle wasn't enough... you saw through me.
Magetto! Don't cry! Ugh, so sensitive.

before: Master Vegara said a Saiyar grows stronger when pushed to the edge. Please, push me!
after: Thank you. I learned more from this fight than from years of training.

before: My Time-Skip works for one tenth of a second. That is all I need.
Hitto is Universe 6's legendary assassin! You're done!
Then I'll be faster than a tenth of a second.
after: Impressive. You adapted to my technique. Until we meet again.

before: Rosé. Beautiful, isn't it? A god's power in a mortal's body.
He's the one who destroyed my future!
after: Zamazu... it's time we became one.

before: I am justice. I am the world. Bow to me, mortals.
This world is all I have left. I'm not giving it up!
after: A mortal... defeating a god...? No. I am everywhere...
Zenno has erased this timeline's Zamazu. We have to go back.

before: Justice is my strength. And for Universe 11, I will become a God of Destruction.
after: To lose like this... Jiran will finish this.

before: Kaulifla and Kael, fused with Potaro. Twice the Saiyar, twice the power!
I'm not going to hold back.
after: Out of the ring... that's not fair! Next time!

before: Strength is everything. Trust is a weakness.
Fight with everything you've got! We'll be right behind you!
Then I'll show you what trust can do.
He's not evil! Paragos forced him to fight... please, just stop him!
Easy, Brolo. I don't want to hurt you.
after: We'll take him somewhere quiet. Somewhere he can just live.

before: Such a lovely planet. I think I'll eat it.
Star Patrol! Morro, you are under arrest!
after: My magic... you'll pay for this... I'll be back.
He'll be locked away. For now.

before: Morro's army doesn't need permission to take this planet.
after: Good work. But Morro is still out there, and he's gathering power.

before: I've absorbed Seven-Three's abilities and a whole planet's life. Give up.
Remember what I taught you: don't think. Just move.
Your magic won't work on me.
after: Then my job here is done. Goodbye... and keep training.

before: I gave up my life to become the strongest in the universe. Saiyars will pay for what they did.
He carries a grudge. Understand it, but don't let it crush you.
after: The truth... wasn't what I thought.
Hmph. Your revenge has the wrong target.

before: My wish made me the strongest in the universe. Shall I show you?
He's burning his own life to fight. Don't let up!
after: Strongest... in the universe... was a lie...
It's over. But I sense... something else coming.

before: Ten years of training in a time chamber. Meet my newest form.
after: Hmph. A little surprise. Next time I'll come fully prepared.

before: Crimson Ribbon Army. Gama 1. I fight as a superhero.
They've been lied to. Don't destroy them, just stop them!
Gama 2, the most heroic of them all. Time for my pose!
after: Then let's do one last heroic thing...
Majenta has released Cel Max! Everyone, get ready!

before: It's a mindless giant. Its weak spot is on its head!
after: It's over. Panna's safe. We... actually did it.
